title: The 1-Chat, 1-Automation Rule: How I shipped 30 days of content with AI tooling
caption:
How I shipped 30 days of content with AI tooling

Here's the exact playbook:
1️⃣ Commit to one LLM — ChatGPT, Claude, or Gemini. 30 days. Depth beats sampling.
2️⃣ Pick one automation tool — Zapier or Make. Learn its patterns instead of hopping platforms.
3️⃣ Add one visual tool — Canva or Napkin for assets. Three tools cover 90% of the work.
4️⃣ No new tool for 30 days — Every shiny launch gets a no. Depth compounds; tab-hopping doesn't.
